title: Souffle of Raspberries
description: Prepared with raspberries, rind, and juice.
steps: Rub through a sieve a pint of raspberries
Grate the rind of a lemon and the juice of 1/2 a lemon
Add 1 lb. of powdered sugar
Let it simmer till it thickens a little
Turn it out to get cold
Beat up the yolks of 8 eggs
Grate 3 stale sponge cakes
Beat the eggs and cakes together
Add the snow of 3 eggs slowly
Mix in 2 oz. of melted veal fat
Grease a mould and sift sugar over
Bake in a slow oven

steps: Chop three lettuces, a large handful of spinach, a little chervil, a head of celery, two or three carrots, and four onions

Let them fry till slightly browned
Season with a little salt, sifted white sugar, and white pepper

Add a tablespoon of flour, stirring all the time.

Place it again on the fire to boil
Add to two quarts of soup one quarter of a pound of rice

title: Spaetzlen Or Spatzen
description: Prepared with water or milk, bread crumbs, and flour.
steps: Sift two cups of flour into a bowl, make a depression in the centre and break into it two eggs
Add a saltspoon of salt and enough water or milk to form a smooth, stiff dough
Set on some water to boil, salt the water
When the water boils, drop the spaetzle into it, one at a time, using the spoon with which you cut the dough, or roll it on a board into a round roll and cut them with a knife
When the spaetzle are done, they will rise to the surface, take them out with a perforated skimmer and lay them on a platter
Heat two tablespoons of butter and add bread crumbs, let them brown for a minute and pour all over the spaetzle

title: Spanish Omelet
description: Prepared with tomatoes, onions, and olive oil or butter.

ingredients.name: one large or two medium-sized white Texas onions

steps: In a chopping bowl place two nice large ripe tomatoes, first peeling them; one large or two medium-sized white Texas onions, two sprigs of parsley, and one large green-bell pepper, first removing most of its seeds.
Chop these ingredients well together quite fine, turn them into a saucepan and let them cook over rather a brisk heat until quite soft.
Put no water in this mixture.
Add a tablespoon of olive oil or of butter before it begins to cook and season well with salt and red pepper.
Make the omelet the same as the plain one, but use water instead of milk in mixing it, and only use two tablespoons of water for the six eggs required.

After the eggs are sufficiently beaten, mixed, and in the pan over the fire, and when the edges begin to stiffen, cover the surface of the omelet to within an inch of the edge with the cooked vegetables.
Fold the omelet quickly and turn it on a hot platter.
Pour around it all the vegetables left in the pan and serve.

title: Spanish Onions Filled with Forced Meat

steps: Boil 3 Spanish onions in water with some salt for three-quarters of an hour
Take them out and put them to drain in a colander
When cold, make a slit down with a knife to enable you to strip each leaf without breaking them
Place each onion on a separate plate
Prepare 1 lb. of forced meat as for balls and season it well
Divide it in three and form them into balls
Begin with the smallest leaf, not the heart, and go on replacing the leaves till you make up the three onions again
Have in a stewpan the hearts of the onions, some salt, pepper, a little marjoram, grated nutmeg, and 1/2 pint of stock

steps: Pare the apples (Pound Sweets are best; crab-apples may be pickled the same way, but do not pare)

Spice with an ounce of cinnamon bark and half an ounce of cloves, removing the heads
Heat slowly to a boil with a pint of water
Add the vinegar and spices and boil until tender
Take out the fruit with a perforated skimmer and spread upon dishes to cool
Boil the syrup thick and pack the apples in jars and pour the syrup over them boiling hot

ingredients.name: 1 cup best pickling vinegar per quart of cherries

Put little splints of wood across the tops of the fruit to prevent rising to the top
Boil the vinegar and spices and sugar for five minutes steady
Turn out into a covered stoneware vessel, cover, and let it get cold
Pour over the fruit and repeat this process three days in succession
Remove the heads of the cloves, for they will turn the fruit black

title: Spinach
description: Prepared with spinach, salt, and water.
steps: Cut off the roots and pick spinach over carefully, cutting off all the withered leaves and stems
Put the leaves in cold salt water to soak for half an hour
Shake the leaves about and turn them over several times
Drop them in a large pan of water and rinse well
Lift them out separately and drop back into a second pan of water
Continue washing in fresh water until there is not a grain of sand to be found in the bottom of the pan
Let a cup of water come to a boil
Lift the spinach out of the cold water pan with the water dripping from it and put it into the pot into the boiling water
Put the lid on the pot
Turn the fire a little low and let it cook slowly for fifteen minutes, stirring every now and then to keep it from sticking to the bottom of the pot
Just before taking up the spinach put some salt in it
Drain off the water and put a big tablespoon of butter and one-quarter teaspoon of pepper in it

title: String Bean Salad
description: A salad made with beans, lemon juice, and salt.
steps: String and remove the ends from one quart of beans. Cut into short lengths. Cover with boiling water, add one level tablespoon of salt and cook until tender, but not soft. title: Sugar Cookies
description: A biscuit made with sugar, lemon rind, and brandy.
steps: In a mixing bowl put a cup of sweet butter and two cups of granulated sugar; beat these ingredients to a cream, then add three eggs, grated lemon rind, and four tablespoons of brandy.
Beat the added ingredients thoroughly with the others till the mixture is smooth and creamy.

Sift three cups of flour in a big bowl with a teaspoon of salt and three teaspoons of baking-powder; stir this a little at a time in the bowl with the other ingredients, until the mixture is a light dough, just stiff enough to roll out.
Dust the pastry board well with flour, put part of the dough on the board, toss it lightly with your hands from side to side till the dough is covered with flour.
Dust the rolling-pin well with flour and roll the dough very thin; cut it in shapes with a cookie cutter.
Lift each cookie up carefully with a pancake turner, slip them quickly in a big baking-pan, the inside of which has been well rubbed with flour, and bake them in a moderate oven till light brown.
Just a moment before taking the pan out of the oven sprinkle the surface of the cookies lightly with granulated sugar.
When a little cool take the cookies out of the pan with the pancake turner and lay them on a big platter.

title: Sulze von Kalbsfuessen (Calf's Foot Jelly), No. 2
description: Prepared with calf's head, calf's feet, and onions.
steps: Clean calf's head and calf's feet carefully
Let them lay in cold water for half an hour
Set on to boil with four quarts of water
Add two or three small onions, a few cloves, salt, one teaspoon of whole peppers, two or three bay leaves, juice of a large lemon, one cup of white wine and a little white wine vinegar
Let this boil slowly for five or six hours until reduced one-half
Strain through a fine hair sieve and let it stand ten or twelve hours
Remove the meat from the bones and when cold cut into fine pieces
Add the boiled brains
Skim off every particle of fat from the jelly and melt slowly
Add one teaspoon of sugar and the whipped whites of three eggs and boil very fast for about fifteen minutes, skimming well
Taste and if not tart enough, add a dash of vinegar
Strain through a flannel bag, do not squeeze or shake it until the jelly ceases to run freely
Remove the bowl and put another under for the remaining jelly
Wet your mould, put in the jelly and set in a cool place

title: To Stew Fowl—Brown
description: Prepared with fowl, onion, and garlic.

ingredients.name: a little walnut liquor or mushroom ketchup

steps: Cut up the fowl as for the last stew, put in a stewpan an onion chopped, also a tooth of garlic, some marjoram and lemon thyme, a little walnut liquor or mushroom ketchup.
Then place in the pieces of fowl, let it boil up, then put it at the side to simmer, put in a few balls.
When done rub in a basin a spoonful of flour, the juice of a lemon, a little browning to colour, stir it into the stew.
Dish it up.

title: To Stew Globe Artichokes
description: Prepared with artichokes, garlic, and juice.
steps: Take 6 fresh ones, cut off the stalks, peel them, and cut them in pieces
Take off all the hard leaves, cut them in quarters, cut out the chokes, wash them well
Put in a stewpan 1 pint of oil, cut in 2 teeth of garlic, let it fry a light brown
Take out the garlic, put in a tea-cup of boiling water with salt and pepper
Lay in the artichokes with a little dried saffron, let them stew till quite tender
Add the juice of a lemon, mix it well with the liquor
Dish them up in a deep dish. To be eaten cold

title: To Stew Halibut's Head
description: Prepared with halibut, onions, and liver.

ingredients.name: juice of 2 large lemons or more

steps: Slice in a stewpan 3 or 4 onions with 3 tablespoonfuls of oil
Let it fry
Put in pint of water, salt, pepper, ground mace
Lay in the pieces of the head
Make a few balls of some of the flesh of the halibut and a piece of the liver
Lay them on top
Have a good egg sauce ready to pour over it
Rub in a basin 4 eggs, a little dried saffron, chopped parsley and the juice of 2 large lemons or more, according to taste
Dish it up very carefully
Lay the balls round
Pour over some of the sauce
Put the remainder in a sauce-boat

title: To Stew Jerusalem Artichokes
description: Prepared with jerusalem artichokes, onion, and butter.
steps: Before peeling the artichokes wash them well, free of all dirt, in 2 or 3 waters.
Dry them on a coarse cloth, then peel them and put them in cold water for 10 minutes.
Chop an onion very fine like a mince, put it in a saucepan with 1 ounce of butter, salt, pepper, a little grated nutmeg, 1 teacup of milk.
Cut the artichokes in halves, let them simmer till done, careful they do not break.
Stir in a basin a teaspoonful of flour with a little water.
Pour it over the artichokes, dish them up.

title: To Stew Pears
description: Prepared with pears, brown sugar, and rind.
steps: Take 6 fine-looking pears, halve them, and take out the core
Lay them in a stewpan with 1 lb. of brown sugar, 1 pint of water, the rind of a lemon, a few cloves, and 2 spoonfuls of vinegar
Stew them gently for 4 or 5 hours
The vinegar will make them red as coral

title: To Stew Peas with Eggs
description: Prepared with peas, eggs, and onion.

ingredients.name: 2 spoonfuls of oil or 1/2 lb. of butter

steps: Fry an onion sliced in 2 spoonfuls of oil, or 1/2 lb. of butter; salt and pepper.
Pick carefully 1 peck of peas, wash and drain them.
Put them in the saucepan with the oil and onion.
Add a teacup of boiling water, 3 or 4 lumps of sugar, chop a little fresh mint.
Let it all cook till the peas are done.
Break 5 or 6 eggs, each one separately in a cup, put them on the peas.
Let them cook till they are done, dish up carefully.
